description: This file defines the TransactionClient class which manages transaction execution within Orleans framework environment, including handling different transaction options, starting, committing, aborting, and finalizing transactions. It also features methods for running delegates within specific transaction contexts.

classes.name: TransactionClient
classes.description: Implements the ITransactionClient interface to manage transaction execution, including creation, commitment, abortion, and exception handling, within the Orleans transactional environment.

methods.name: RunTransaction
methods.description: Overloaded methods that execute a provided delegate within a transactional context, handling different transaction options such as create, join, suppress, etc.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithDisallowedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate when transactions are disallowed, throwing exception if ambient transaction exists.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithSupportedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate respecting the current transaction context, either running standalone or joining an existing transaction.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithSupressedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate with transaction context suppressed (cleared), restoring it afterwards.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new transaction or forks an existing one, sets the transaction context, runs the delegate, and handles commit or abort based on outcome.

methods.name: FinalizeTransaction
methods.description: Finalizes the transaction, attempting to resolve or abort based on transaction state, and propagates exceptions if needed.
